inputs: A 32,768-element and a 2,097,152-element prefix of a single xorshift32 stream seeded 71362147. Elements are reduced modulo 1001 minus 500. Each executable constructs the array from N and seed then computes the maximum sum of a nonempty contiguous subarray, including generation and allocation in every score.

models.floor: (Ts + c)/(Tr + c), c = max(0 ns, 7000000 ns - Tr); Ts and Tr are the solver and its own reference baseline scores.

success: On each independent boot the reference floor must strictly lower the median absolute relative error across the four solver/input comparisons against the baseline, without increasing false accepts or false timeouts across the five registered deadlines. Report native mixed cells separately. Report global-offset results, whether short/long references straddle 7ms, and each per-case ratio regardless of outcome. Pooled estimates are descriptive.
